summary: John Biro, 67, of Irwin found deceased in his home at the Irwin Townsite; Mt. Crested Butte Police notified ~1:30 a.m., a Crested Butte SAR team (2 members) plus a police officer and the county coroner launched ~2 a.m. for a winter backcountry body recovery (snow-machine access only), all out of the backcountry by 5:40 a.m.; coroner ruled natural death from chronic medical conditions.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte Police; Gunnison County coroner
notes: Natural death at home, not a rescue — SAR's role was only the winter backcountry body recovery; consistent with precedent id 2437 (Robert Rozman, 2021-12-12, Irwin natural-death snowmobile recovery).
